curl with a browser user-agent as a fallback when WebFetch returned 403
up to 2 WebSearch queries per still-unsupported number, followed by a WebFetch of the most promising result

Alaska DEC's 18 AAC 87 regulation page (dec.alaska.gov) sits behind a captcha wall (geo.captcha-delivery.com) and could not be fetched by any method tried.

Power and Water Corporation's remote-power-sources page, NMI News Service's Bavi recovery post, North of 60 Mining News' Red Dog articles, and NOVAGOLD's own Donlin infrastructure page all returned persistent 403s; the underlying numbers (IES station counts, Saipan MW, Red Dog Life Extension budget, Donlin plant MW) rest on search-engine snippets of those same pages rather than independent fetches.
WA off-grid mine diesel/hybrid $/kWh figures (0.50 / 0.25-0.35) and the Global Fund's $128 million non-Global-Fund figure were not found in any reachable source within the 2-search budget.
Ekati's 30.8 MW / seven 4.4 MW generator figures were found only in an inaccessible secondary (grokipedia.com, 404) and remain unconfirmed by any fetched page.
